lines.say: blocks the enzyme that turns testosterone into DHT, lowering DHT in blood and scalp
hair improved in 48% versus 7% on placebo at one year; lost within a year of stopping
enlarged-prostate surgery and urinary retention about halved over 4 years
PSA falls by about half; any confirmed rise from its lowest is evaluated
infertility and poor semen quality reported after approval
erection, desire and ejaculation problems; some reported to last after stopping
suicidal thoughts, a side effect EU regulators confirmed in 2025; depression reported
more high-grade prostate cancer (1.8% versus 1.1% over 7 years)
breast tenderness or enlargement (2.2% versus 0.7%); male breast cancer reported
